context_diversity.idea: More cells from a few contexts do not establish transfer to new biological contexts.
context_diversity.task_caveat: A position/research argument, not evidence of any leaderboard leader architecture or a promised score.

scdebart.status: ICML2026 proceedings abstract and pinned author source inspected; full PDF not successfully retrieved
scdebart.idea: Pretrain on basal-conditioned expression changes rather than static expression reconstruction.
scdebart.task_caveat: Reported fine-tuned Perturb-seq benchmarks are not the VCC controls-only unseen-context task. No checkpoint run here; pinned released code audit has reproducibility findings.

systema.status: Peer-reviewed primary paper excerpts and author project inspected
systema.idea: Compare against average response and measure perturbation-specific identity, not only shared systematic response.
systema.task_caveat: Source-context MSE gains against identity can be trivial if a constant mean is stronger.

c3tl.idea: Encode shared perturbation effects and context, predict quantitative response from paired evidence.
c3tl.task_caveat: Its displayed context encoder aggregates measured context responses; arbitrary unseen contexts are not identifiable without assumptions. Not treated as a ready controls-only zero-shot predictor.

trade.status: Peer-reviewed primary abstract/method snippets and author data description inspected
trade.idea: Noisy measured DE hides weaker effects; response signal and dosage differ across perturbations and contexts.
trade.task_caveat: Does not show that every competition target is nonessential or establish their effects in anonymous A/B/C.
